articles.title: Stablecoin firm Brale says new protocol can remove a major hurdle to scaling custom tokens
articles.snippet: Today's bridge model won't scale as hundreds of companies issue their own stablecoins, fragmenting liquidity, Brale CEO Ben Milne said in an interview.

articles.title: UK policy sprint finds cross-border payments are stablecoins’ top use case
articles.snippet: Industry participants said stablecoins offer the biggest near-term benefits for cross-border payments, while domestic UK retail adoption is likely to remain limited.

articles.title: South Korea plans stablecoin rules as opposition pushes crypto tax repeal
articles.snippet: The FSC reportedly plans a government-backed digital asset bill covering stablecoins and exchanges, while opposition lawmakers seek to scrap a 22% crypto tax due in 2027.

articles.title: Visa outlines stablecoin strategy during Q3 earnings call
articles.snippet: Visa said it is investing across the stablecoin stack, highlighting OpenUSD, tokenized deposits and AI-powered commerce during the company’s third-quarter earnings call.
